test.meaning: A cupel or cupelling hearth in which precious metals are melted for trial and refinement.
To refine (gold, silver, etc.) in a test or cupel; to subject to cupellation.

law.meaning: The body of binding rules and regulations, customs and standards established in a community by its legislative and judicial authorities.
A binding regulation or custom established in a community in this way.
To work as a lawyer; to practice law.
To prosecute or sue (someone), to litigate.

sophisticated.meaning: To make less natural or innocent.
To practice sophistry; change the meaning of, or be vague about in order to mislead or deceive.
Having obtained worldly experience, and lacking naiveté; cosmopolitan.
